What we do

Pest control services

Integrated pest management is the best way to combat pests — applied thoughtfully, safely and effectively to active and target areas in and around your property.

Ant Control

Odorous house ants and carpenter ants — stopped at the entry points and eliminated before they damage your home.

Spider Control

Spiders kept out of your home and off your property, season after season.

Rodent Control

Rodents live everywhere in close proximity to humans — we stop them from choosing your home as theirs.

Wasp & Hornet Removal

Wasp and hornet nests appear almost overnight in summer — we deal with them so you can enjoy your time outside.

Flea Control

Fleas are most prolific in the fall and can make your home unbearable — we eliminate them and make your space livable again.

Seasonal Pest Control

Preventative seasonal plans — quarterly, bi-monthly or on-demand — that protect your home or property all year long.

About us

Why seasonal pest control?

There are many types of insects, spiders and other bugs that live happily in the Pacific Northwest, and rodents are abundant here as well. Insects and rodents can easily find everything they need to thrive around your home and yard. With years of experience in the pest control industry, The Ant Sir Pest Solutions knows exactly how and when to prepare for rodents and insects when they become pests in your home or office.

  • Integrated pest management — safe, effective, targeted
  • Entry points found and sealed off
  • No contracts — quarterly, bi-monthly or on-demand
  • Free inspection & estimates, with follow-ups
How it works

Pests change with the seasons — so do we

01

Winter

Pests seek warmth and shelter around your home. Odorous house ants and rodents stay active all winter — we keep them out.

02

Spring

Ants, spiders, rodents and insects multiply fast. We look for entry points, seal them off, and safely eliminate the pests.

03

Summer

Spider and insect activity peaks. Wasp and hornet nests appear overnight — we deal with them so you can enjoy your home.

04

Fall

Pests move indoors to survive the cold. Fleas are at their worst — we eliminate them and make your space livable again.
